title: Strengthen the test-results redraw tests: determinism under redraws and a one-sided limit
findings_note: Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs: the redraw-determinism test is weak and no test covers a redraw against a one-sided limit.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Follow-up from ob-20: the redraw-determinism test is weak, and no test covers a redraw against a one-sided limit. Targeted to v0.2.0. Runs after the generation-behaviour bundle, because that changes how out-of-limit values are drawn.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs only. Production code changes only if a test exposes a real bug, which then goes to the owner as a finding.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Determinism under redraws: a config whose distribution forces many redraws per cell (for example a normal with most of its mass outside narrow limits, still above the 1% floor), generated twice with the same seed over at least 2k devices, gives byte-identical files. A different seed gives a different file. The test also asserts that redraws actually happened, for example via an internal counter or by showing that at least one raw-distribution draw would have printed outside the limits; a test that would pass with no redraws does not count.
- One-sided limit, upper only and lower only: with outOfLimitRate 0, no in-limit value prints past the single limit or exactly on it, for a continuous distribution wider than the limit. With outOfLimitRate 100, every value prints past that limit, on the correct side.
- Mutation-check each new test: it must fail when the redraw loop is replaced by a single draw, and when the one-sided comparison is flipped.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add the tests next to the existing test-results redraw tests, and reuse their helpers for inline configs and for parsing the output. If observing redraws needs a hook, add an `internal` counter on `TestResultsGenerator` (the tests already reach `Write(Stream)` as internal) rather than anything public.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run the focused tests, then `dotnet test Obfuscator.slnx` and `dotnet format Obfuscator.slnx --verify-no-changes`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Tests only, plus an internal test hook if one is needed.
